'''Shrokaan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Baroli sector/Legends|Baroli sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. During the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] executed a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] on the [[twelve-bladed satellite of Shrokaan]] by exposing him to the void of space, as he was too dangerous to capture alive.
